race.description: Shedboss Central West Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: PATRIKA EXPRESS (4) was given plenty of time to mature prior to making her debut as a 4YO at Dubbo 11 days ago where she bolted in by over 4 lengths. She has to shoulder an extra 2kg here, but looks set to progress further, and she can take the net step immediately. GIOVANNA STAR (11) does not help herself by settling back in her races, and will be resuming from a spell that would have done her the world of good. She may need the run, but outside of the top pick, this field is not strong, and she can make up the quinella. Watch for her late. CAN DO IT (3) is a durable 9YO gelding who has not been over-taxed with racing. He resumes from a spell and has been placed in 5 of his 9 starts fresh up in the past. Keep him safe in all top 4 combos. VICIOUS RUMOUR (6) is also resuming from a spell after making progress last season. She benefits from a 1.5kg claim and will be ready to rumble. Check the market moves.
